description: This PHP source file defines a class LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport for generating a leave entitlement and usage report within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes report header and filter definitions, data retrieval, validation rules, and access control logic related to leave types and employee leave entitlement usage.

classes.name: LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport
classes.description: This class generates a report for leave entitlements and usage, including headers, filters, data retrieval, validation, and access control logic.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the report header with columns for employee name, entitlement days, pending approval days, scheduled days, taken days, and balance days.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns an empty filter object for the report.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and extracts filter parameters from request, including employee IDs, leave type, job title, subunit, location, date range, and sorting/pagination settings.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for request parameters, ensuring entity existence and correct data formats.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the report; throws ForbiddenException if not authorized.
